name: Newport Beach Ocean Lifeguard Trainee
org: City of Newport Beach Fire Department, Lifeguard Operations
what_you_do: Train at the Basic Lifeguard Academy. You learn rescues, CPR and emergency medical response. You also learn to spot rip currents.
who_can_apply: You must be 16 years old on or before March 30, 2027. No lifeguard experience is needed. You must pass a 1000-meter ocean swim and a 1000-meter run-swim-run tryout.
pay_detail: Paid training is $16.90 an hour. Lifeguard I pay is $25.50 to $31.02 an hour.
deadline_text: Applications close January 20, 2027 at 5:00 p.m. The tryout is planned for Saturday, January 30, 2027, with check-in at 8:30 a.m. An info night is Wednesday, January 6, 2027, 6:00 to 7:30 p.m.
how_to_apply: Apply online for the Lifeguard Trainee job. If you qualify, you are invited to a tryout. Top finishers get an interview. You must also pass the Basic Lifeguard Academy.
notes: Practice workout schedule is on the program page. Dates can change with weather. The tryout has no wetsuits or fins. The info night is at Lifeguard Headquarters, 70 Newport Pier, in person or on Zoom, and is not required. Paid work for people under 18 in California needs a Permit to Employ and Work.
